artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.5 x 17.5 cm (10 1/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude woman standing in a decorative architectural setting. She holds a sword in one hand, with the other hand slightly raised. One leg is slightly bent. Her facial expression is serene, with long hair flowing down her shoulders. She is draped in a cloth, with no visible jewelry. The background features classical architectural elements like arches, columns, and ornate details, along with a tiled floor.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a detailed line drawing depicting a group of individuals carrying large wooden beams under the supervision of figures holding staffs. In the background, there is a fortified structure with towers and an open gate. A banner with an emblematic design is seen fluttering above. The clothing and headgear styles suggest a historic setting. The figures show a sense of effort and movement as they walk along a cobblestone path.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures around an infant in a rustic setting. The image is done in the style of a classic religious or allegorical scene. The scene is set in what appears to be a stable or structure with exposed brick, archways, and simple materials. There's a focus on an infant lying in a manger, surrounded by attendees who are gathered closely. One figure stands to the left, holding a crook. In the background, through the arched opening, a landscape is visible featuring a barren tree and distant figures. Detailed etching work emphasizes the texture of fabric, wood, and stone, typical of fine linework in early 16th-century engravings.

artworks.title: Tarquin and Lucretia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural setting. The scene shows two central figures in a tension-filled moment. One figure stands holding a sword next to a bed, while the other sits on the bed. The setting includes vaulted arches, pillars, and a candle holder on the bed. In the background, there is a glimpse of outdoor space through the archways, with figures engaged in conversation and a person riding a horse. The walls and structures are detailed with a textured appearance, showcasing intricate linework and etching style.

artworks.title: Allegory of Envy
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.7 x 18.3 cm (10 1/8 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This print shows five adults and one child depicted in various poses in an outdoor setting. In the center is one standing woman, surrounded on either side by two couples. All the people have pale skin and are nude, although the woman in the center and one woman on the right have thin cloths draped around their hips. The couple on the left is seated on a rock, one person sitting on the other's lap, their legs intertwined. The other couple stands, their arms around each other's waists. The woman in the center appears old, with sharp features and deep wrinkles on her face. She is looking downward towards the ground. In the bottom left corner, a cherubic child sits on the ground, looking up at her. The ground beneath the people is rocky, with small patches of grass. In the background, there are tall trees on the left and a path leading to a town on a hill on the right, under a clear sky. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Battle of Cividale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene involving soldiers with pikes and flags. The drawing depicts a chaotic skirmish between two groups of armored soldiers. Each group holds long pikes, creating a dense line across the front lines of battle. Soldiers in various poses show the struggle; some are advancing, while others are fallen or leaning backward. Flags billow above them. The background features a central mountain or hill, with clouds and a crescent shape hanging in the sky above. The artwork is filled with detailed linework emphasizing texture and energy.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt at a Fountain
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand fountain inside an arched architectural space. The scene features a multi-tiered fountain with carvings and ornamental designs. Surrounding the base of the fountain are sculptures of cherubic figures. The backdrop showcases a vaulted ceiling with arched columns, supporting the arches. The drawing highlights line work and hatching for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Rebecca and Eliezer (Le pont de bois)
Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring several figures in a dynamic scene. Some figures wear armor and helmets, wielding weapons, while a central figure carries a cross. Other individuals surround the central figure, engaging in various actions. The drawing is detailed, with intricate linework defining the characters' features and expressions. Vertical lines in the background hint at architectural elements. The overall tone of the drawing is intense, depicting a moment of tension and movement.

artworks.title: The Virgin Appearing to Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate black and white illustration. It depicts a seated man, a crowned woman holding a child, and an eagle. The man has curly hair and a beard, wearing draped robes and holding a writing quill. The woman wears a crown and her hair flows down her back. The child has curly hair and is seated on the woman's lap. They are surrounded by flowing garments that extend to a crescent moon. The background features decorative cloud formations and light rays. Elaborate calligraphic text appears above the illustration.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint John
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a cauldron surrounded by a crowd. The scene includes classical architecture in the background and various characters with distinct expressions and clothing. One man is stoking the fire under the cauldron with a staff.

artworks.title: The Vision of the Seven Candlesticks
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. The primary figure is seated on a circular structure, with long hair and a beard. Lines radiate from the head, and the person wears a robe and holds an open book and a staff. The secondary figure kneels at the base, wearing a similar robe and holding a candlestick. Surrounding them are tall candlesticks with candles on stands. The background features swirling clouds.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Lamb
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures surrounding a central lamb. The drawing is highly detailed, featuring various figures gathered around a radiant circular motif containing the lamb. Around the lamb are different creatures and numerous figures. Some figures are crowned, while others hold palm fronds. In the lower segment, there are figures on clouds, suggesting a spiritual atmosphere. The drawing is rich in linework and symbolism, typical of intricate religious iconography from medieval or renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: The Seven Angels with the Trumpets
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing an apocalyptic scene with angels, divine figures, and celestial phenomena. The image is detailed, depicting a heavenly assembly with angels, a central figure, and radiant lines. The angels have trumpets and some are flying among the clouds. On Earth, there is chaos with volcanic eruptions, cracks in the ground, and a turbulent sea. Various objects like calligraphy implements and books are in the foreground, set amidst atmospheric clouds. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Saint John Devouring the Book
artworks.description: This drawing features a surreal scene with celestial and terrestrial elements. It shows a landscape with an individual studying a scroll on land, illuminated by light from a radiant celestial face in the sky. Surrounding the central figure are symbolic elements including towering pillars, a sun-like visage, and a figure resembling an angel descending from the clouds. Natural elements such as trees, clouds, water with boats, and an aquatic creature are also depicted. An architectural element resembling a balcony is present in the sky. The drawing is detailed with strong line work and shading, capturing natural textures and fantastical iconography.

artworks.title: The Babylonian Whore
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting fantastical and dramatic elements. The drawing features intricate details showcasing ethereal figures, chaos, armored riders on horses in swirling clouds, a central figure wearing a crown on a multi-headed beast, winged figures flying above, a city in destruction with flames and crashing waves, and people in Renaissance-style attire observing the scene. The composition suggests a dynamic interplay between heaven and earth, chaos and order.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Angels in a Vaulted Hall
artworks.description: The image is a detailed woodcut showing a scene with several figures. In the center foreground, a seated woman is depicted in full-length with her head slightly tilted down, holding a child on her lap. The child is facing forward and reaching out towards another figure. Both the woman and child have gentle facial features, and the woman's hair is covered by a draped headpiece. Around them are two angels with large wings, standing on either side, and a bearded man standing to the right, observing the scene with a gentle gesture toward them. The figures wear flowing gowns. Behind them is an archway with a round, recessed detail in the center. In the upper corners of the arch are figures resembling mythological characters.

artworks.title: Shere Mill Pond (The Larger Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water, trees, and the sky. The etching depicts detailed natural elements like reeds and reflections in the water. The color palette is monochromatic using black and white to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child with the Cat and Snake
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene featuring a seated figure holding a small bundle. The figure is seated with a chair nearby, a fabric spread over a surface, and a window behind them emitting light. The artwork showcases intricate line work, typical of etching techniques, reminiscent of Rembrandt's style known for conveying emotional depth and detailed environments.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria: an Arched Print
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene near a well with architectural and landscape details. The foreground shows a well with intricate masonry. One figure is leaning on the side of the well and another is standing beside it holding a large vessel. The lines are detailed, capturing fabric drapery and expressions. In the background, a group of figures and a horse are shown amidst lush trees, set against hilly architecture.

artworks.title: Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an encounter between two individuals. The scene depicts one person kneeling and embracing another person, who is bending forward with open arms. The kneeling figure appears disheveled with torn clothing, while the standing figure is dressed in long robes. In the background, there is intricate architecture and other figures near a doorway. The foreground shows steps leading up to the main figures. The drawing features fine line work and detailed cross-hatching in a classic etching style.

artworks.title: The Artist Drawing from the Model
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures and objects. In the bottom left, there is a seated figure. In the center, a standing figure appears surrounded by shading and unfinished lines. To the right, another figure or statue is draped with fabric, partially obscured by a frond or branch. The background has heavy shading, contrasting with the lightly sketched forms in the foreground.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Cottage and a Large Tree
Old Man with Beard, Fur Cap, and Velvet Cloak
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly person from the chest up. The individual is seated upright, with one arm resting across their body, and their other hand appears to be gently cradled. Their facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a long, flowing white beard extending downwards. The person wears a large hat covering their head, and their hair is hidden beneath it. Their attire consists of a long, thick, dark garment that drapes heavily over their shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background is plain and unadorned, with a simple, textured surface.
